description:
Resolve a token name, ticker or contract address to the token people mean: its CoinGecko id, symbol, market cap and contract on each chain. When several tokens share a name or ticker it returns ranked candidates instead of picking one (copycat tokens reuse names). Call it before research_token or check_token_safety when you only have a name. Example: {"query":"PEPE","chain":"base"}.

Costs 1 credit. Every section carries its own source receipt (provider, fetched_at, runtime_status); a section that fails is listed under missing and never guessed.

chain.description: Chain to return the contract for, for example "eth", "base", "bsc" or "solana".

query.description: A name, ticker or contract address, for example "PEPE", "pepe" or "0x6982…".

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data (default) or 'markdown' for human-readable text.

name: find_token
title: Find Token
